summary: Fixed pyproject.toml (dynamic version attr, requires-python >=3.11, license table and license-files placed for setuptools 66, explicit package-data globs without _drafts plus label templates, packages limited to orbis.postal/orbis.labels so the stray empty src/orbis/__init__.py and _maint stay out of the wheel, console script now orbis.postal.commands:main, entry point group orbis.postal.renderers), MANIFEST.in (no longer drops csv files, excludes tools/timings), and made orbis.postal.__version__ import from _version.py. Verified sdist, wheel-from-sdist and development wheel are identical and install and run correctly; note docs/packaging.md named the entry point group in the singular in one read, but the code, plugins.md and CHANGELOG use the plural orbis.postal.renderers, which I kept.
